title: Fetal Circulation and Birth Changes
purpose: Describe fetal circulation and circulatory changes at birth.
required_visual_model_data: Fetal circulation diagram; post-birth change table

direct_resource.Title: OpenStax: Fetal Circulation
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the fetal circulation section. Observe the fetal shunts and birth changes. Record ductus arteriosus, foramen ovale, ductus venosus, and one post-birth change.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
